public_rationale: A primary evaluation published four days before the post documents hallucinations across contemporary language models. This supports the narrow observation that hallucinations persisted. It does not establish that hallucinations are incurable or that generative AI would collapse.
limitations: The study uses automated fact-checking against collected web sources, which can itself make mistakes.
Its entity-description tasks do not establish a hallucination rate for all everyday uses.
The paper reports a July assessment without dating each experiment.

statement.document_title: AlphaProof, AlphaGeometry, ChatGPT, and why the future of AI is neurosymbolic

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that contemporary generative AI systems still sometimes present fabricated information as factual.
I use July 2024 through the post date as the latest reporting window for this ongoing technical state. This is not a forecast about the following 12 months.
The claim does not specify an error rate or assert that every system or response hallucinates.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary evaluations document factual fabrications by generative AI systems available during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evidence establishes that factual hallucinations had been eliminated from contemporary generative AI systems.
